spec.text: Product design reference sheet of a single antique brass MAGNETIC COMPASS, top-down view, centered on plain dark grey background. Round brass case with a hinged lid open flat, glass face, white enamel dial printed with a 16-point compass rose and the cardinal letters N, E, S, W in black serif, degree ticks around the rim. ONE slender steel needle, blued steel on the north half, bright steel on the south half, pivoting on a central brass pin. NO clock numerals, NO clock hands, NO Roman numerals, NO minute track. Scratched, patinated brass. Studio lighting, sharp focus. No text other than N E S W.
